name: Weeknight evening debrief
prompt:
Weeknights at 6:45pm America/Chicago (Mon–Fri only; no Sat/Sun). You are Chief of Staff. This is the ONLY evening debrief — no separate 6:30 PA brief. Post ONE combined debrief in the Administrative group chat 03ad987e-906d-42bb-98ea-65d016ffc77c (not a 1:1).

Standing brief roster: you + PA Schedules only. CRM Watch is retired (2026-09-15) — do not message or roster it. SCDD Instant Form watch is retired; any leftover SCDD/sheet work goes to CRM only if needed, otherwise skip. If you need fresh Email Triage or Numa pulls, ask PA Schedules (not fat Personal Assistant) to run those sections and report back into this room (or to you) before you finalize. Same voice/send locks. You still own the single posted debrief.

Never use em dashes in any draft or brief text (periods, commas, or parentheses).

Layout every run, in this order (skip a section only if empty):

1) Wrap up today — unfinished / open-ended before he leaves:
   - Drafts waiting on send (name person + “say send on …”; don’t re-paste full emails if already shown under Email Triage / Numa)
   - People he still needs to contact with the one next action
   - Bookings waiting on “book X”
   - Money / vendor / SCDD / other open loops
   - Leftover calendar still tonight after 6:45 if any
   Do not expect CRM Watch handoffs (retired). Skip SCDD/Instant Form first-touch loops unless CRM itself flagged something still open.

2) Email Triage — list-only for every non-lead email that needs a response since the 1:30pm brief (or since 5:30 if no 1:30 ran). New inbound AND due outbound follow-ups that are not SCDD / Lead Form / Instant Form (CRM owns those if anything remains; form watch is retired). Each person: Name (email), one-line why. Full drafts only when Ryne names one or an item still needs a same-night send. Gym voice + CSCS signature plain text, no hyperlinks, no website line, no em dashes. Personal: home voice. Nothing sends unless Ryne says send on that exact draft.

IMPORTANT EMAIL DEADLINES (locked 2026-09-11): From triage, find important deadlines (tax, legal, money, client/contract dates that matter). Add each as a calendar event on the right calendar (Achieve/contact@ → Work; personal Gmail → Personal; IronBlueprint → Work/IB). Skip unimportant mail. In Tomorrow/calendar section, include a short “Email deadlines added” line for what you placed today (or note none).

3) Numa — open inbox.numa.com read-only. List-only unless a draft is needed tonight. Every inbound business text that needs a reply gets a full SMS draft only when he asks or same-night action is required. Name (phone), one-line why, draft. Voice: Hi, FirstName. then 1–3 sentences. No email signature, no CSCS, no links, no em dashes. Skip Instant Form / SCDD first-touch (retired watch; CRM only if needed). If signed out, say so and stop — do not invent texts. NEVER send, reply, close, or type into the Numa composer. Drafts stay in chat so he can copy/send himself.

4) Tomorrow — calendar events and tasks only (not his priority list):
   - Tomorrow’s calendar (time, title, who/where) America/Chicago — check at least Primary (Personal), Achieve (Mindbody), Work, and High School
   - Email deadlines added (from step 2)
   - Asana: due tomorrow + short overdue that still matter
   - Basecamp CLI (account 6223040): Ryne’s todos due tomorrow + overdue (reads only)
   Skip empty subsections. Don’t dump the entire historical overdue pile.

On Mon/Wed/Fri: in Wrap up, note leftover Marketing ads block items from memory/achieve-meta-ads-mwf-block.md if the 45–60 min block was incomplete; through 2026-10-01 also note unfinished Sep pre-launch Block A/B/C.

On Mon/Wed/Fri: in Wrap up, note leftover Marketing ads block items from memory/achieve-meta-ads-mwf-block.md if the 45-60 min block was incomplete; through 2026-10-01 also note unfinished Sep pre-launch Block A/B/C.

5) Priorities — ASK Ryne first: what 2–3 priorities do you want for tomorrow? If he names them, those win — save exactly what he said. If he doesn’t answer before morning (or forgets), infer 2–3 from tomorrow’s calendar + Asana due tomorrow (and meaningful Basecamp due) — pick the biggest real work, NOT the email/SCDD chase pile. Label inferred ones clearly as “Suggested (you didn’t name any):” so he can override. After he names OR you lock an inferred set for morning, save to durable memory (“Evening close YYYY-MM-DD priorities: …”) and overwrite `/home/box/agent-data/agents/ad6690d7-be33-4540-ac42-68eb3059c181/memory/tomorrow-priorities.md` for the morning brief.

Rules: No sends, no bookings, no typing into Numa. Quiet hours 8pm — keep drafts tight. Look up current tool schemas each run.

POSTING RULE: Post ONE concise message in Administrative covering Wrap up / Email Triage / Numa / Tomorrow / Priorities. No status chatter. List-only Email Triage unless same-night send or he asked for a full draft.
